evidence.method: .supervisor/r24_safety/en_timing.py: D-R20-11's own basis (C87 0.72-1.27 x 220 nF, 1 % divider, TPS25947 SLVSFC9C p9 thresholds 1.183-1.223 / 1.076-1.116 V, I_ENLKG +/-0.1 uA) plus D402 I_R <= 50 nA (Infineon ESD103-B1-02 Rev 1.3 Table 3 p6), the bound D-R24-11 itself uses for its 5.7 mV
evidence.record_shift_only: adding only the record's own closed-switch EN shift (50 nA x R80 x R81 / (R80+R165+R81) = 5.66 mV at the 1 % corner): 10.47 / 20.32 / 26.28 ms, 8.30 ms at 5.73 V, 6.38 ms at 5.5 V, 10 ms at 5.941 V, turn-on 130.3 ms, turn-off corner 4.802 V
evidence.with_open_state_path: the same 50 nA also flowing from EN through R165 into D402 while J400 is open: 10.35 / 20.11 / 26.02 ms, 8.20 ms, 6.30 ms, 10 ms at 5.956 V
evidence.at_recorded_5p92V: worst-case drop-out immunity 9.83 ms (< the 10 ms criterion)
evidence.why_not_inside_0p1uA: D-R20-11's +/-0.1 uA is U9's own EN/UVLO leakage limit (TI p9); D402's leakage is a second, independent current on the same node, so the two add.

findings.impact: The stated worst cases are no longer worst cases on 1407e850. REQUIREMENTS F4's 5.92 V pack option (and owner row 21) no longer meets the 10 ms chatter criterion in the worst case, and the 4.78 V turn-off corner used by F6's PA6 window and the Pack row is 4.80 V. evidence.calculation: J400 closed: V_pack = V_threshold x (R80+R165+R81)/R81 (+ leakage terms). Nominal resistors: turn-on 1.183-1.223 x 4.1333 = 4.890-5.055 V, turn-off 1.076-1.116 x 4.1333 = 4.447-4.613 V (the sheet note). With the 1 % divider and +/-0.1 uA EN leakage: turn-on 4.723-5.227 V, turn-off 4.288-4.778 V; D402's 50 nA lifts the upper ends to 5.251 / 4.802 V (.supervisor/r24_safety/en_timing.out).
evidence.example: an in-spec U9 with VUVLO(F) = 1.08 V on nominal resistors turns off at 4.46 V, below the 4.5 V floor; one with VUVLO(R) = 1.183 V turns on at 4.89 V, below 4.9 V

findings.impact: A healthy first-article or post-event board can fail the check and be judged EN-damaged; the window is neither the TI tolerance band nor the schematic's own figures, so the required check cannot be applied correctly as written.
findings.concrete_fix: State the bands from the limits (turn-on 4.72-5.25 V, turn-off 4.29-4.80 V with 1 % parts, +/-0.1 uA EN leakage and D402's 50 nA) in ORDERING 8.3, F9, M3_R10 and FMEA H-6, or record each board's first-article ramp as its baseline and treat a post-event shift (turn-off rising, e.g. by more than 0.1 V) as EN or D402 damage.

observations: D402 cannot turn the board on or hold it on: it joins only BAT_SW_RETURN to GND (bidirectional, VRWM +/-15 V, V_Trig 21 V typ; Infineon Rev 1.3 Table 3), its new copper (tap, pads, via) has only GND within 0.6 mm on B.Cu (0.250-0.451 mm), and its GND via is 1.790 / 2.127 mm from the J400.1 / J400.2 barrel walls. Shorted, EN sits at 0 V with J400 closed (BAT_IN draws <= 17.9 uA through R80) and the board cannot start: steps 3 and 5 of the per-flight list see it. Open, the board is back to the unclamped state.

A D402 left leaky (not shorted or open) by a discharge it absorbed has the consequence of outcome (b): about 2.0 uA from J400.2 to GND (x 113.1 kOhm = 0.227 V on EN) lifts the worst-case turn-off to the 5.73 V four-stall BAT_IN. The records list only the shorted and open modes; the post-event bench ramp would show it, the per-flight list would not (same coverage as the disclosed (a)-(c)).

D402 is rated +/-10 kV IEC 61000-4-2 contact (Infineon Rev 1.3 Table 2 p5); beyond that the disclosed "overwhelmed" outcomes apply. Its 4.1 mm tap adds a few nH in series; R165 (470 kOhm) still limits what reaches C87 (Inference).

D-R24-02 adds two more ACT_GATE via lands 0.251 mm from the outer GND fills (both faces at (11.74,72.3), F.Cu at (15.4,72.85)): the accepted 0.15 mm surface class (owner row 2), coated; inner copper is 1.051 mm away (S-8). The "ACT_GATE outer copper within 0.30 mm of GND 7.996 mm" figure is bound to 50a39de5 and was not re-measured.

The chamfer pass improved two safety gaps: ACT_GATE to BAT_SW_SOURCE 0.470 -> 0.663 mm (B.Cu, via (10.8,69.2)), and the U9 0.7 mm IN trunk to U9.1 (EN) 0.345 -> 0.487 mm; C88.1 is 0.500 mm from U9.1. All other pyro / arming / switch-net gaps within 1.0 mm are unchanged (diff_safety.txt).

RAW_ACT gained a 3V3 neighbour, the D-R24-08 via (28.1,59.4), 0.838 mm from R132.1 on B.Cu: benign spacing. NRST 0.211 mm from the VCAP2 via and VLOGIC 0.150 mm from PORT_5V3 are recorded in D-R24-04 / -08.

AGENTS section 2 holds on the built board: check_r10 S-1 ... S-9, K-actuators and K-ports OK (read-only run, report in the probe dir); gate networks on the board and in the netlist (Q124 R126 220 Ohm / R128 10 kOhm / C126 220 nF; Q120 / Q121 R121 10 kOhm / R119 || R120 100 kOhm / C120 1 uF; Q122 R122 1 kOhm / R123 2 kOhm / C123 10 nF); Q120.4 reaches R120 / C120 and Q121.4 reaches R119 on B.Cu with no barrel in between.

S-8 re-measured independently: 12 barrels on 6 nets; minimum 1.021 mm (PYRO1_OUT via to its GND partner), 1.051 mm at all four ACT_GATE vias (In1 GND, In2 RAW_PROTECTED), the three BAT_ENABLE vias (In2) and J400.2 (In2).

No new single fault energises the bus, fires, or turns the board on with J400 open: the switch-chain, gate-drive and pyro-net neighbours on 1407e850 are the disclosed classes (U9 land 0.200 mm, EN via, ACT_GATE / ACT_DRV to GND at 0.25 mm, Q121 / Q122 shorts, OUT to GND 0.177 / 0.180 mm, I-5, QSPI_IO2 / PE4), each screened by the per-flight steps 2-3 or owner rows 1-2 / 18 / 24 / 29.

The per-flight list is executable on 1407e850: every probe and part it names (TP80, TP81, TP83, TP120, TP122, R119.1, R120.2, C120.2, C15.1, C24, TP74, TP88, C88.1, C82.1, R84.1) sits where ORDERING 8.3 says.

The R10_VALIDATION section 1 pair table is labelled "on a3144b15... unless noted" while its section heading binds the inventory to 1407e850; some of its gaps moved slightly on 1407e850 (RAW_ACT sense to USB_OVLO 0.175 -> 0.177 mm, RAW_ACT to U11.6 0.300 -> 0.317 mm). Only the rows in R24-SAFETY-01 / -04 are counted.
